what_it_is: HAL Do-228 is listed in this atlas as a light transport and multirole (in_production). The atlas legacy record attributes it to Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (Transport Aircraft Division, Kanpur). L2 (component manufacturing) for many airframe components; L3 (system integration) for the upgraded avionics package; L1 (assembly) for the airframe as a whole. Design authority is General Atomics AeroTec Systems (GA-ATS) since 2020; design IP is not Indian (TD0).
